title: Ayesha and Ali add the hills

scenes.caption: Ayesha and Ali.
scenes.say: Ayesha and Ali climb three hills near Murree. They want the total height.

scenes.caption: Three heights.
scenes.say: The first hill is 2,345 metres. The second is 1,432 metres.

scenes.caption: Line up the columns.
scenes.say: Line up the digits in columns. Start with the ones on the right.

scenes.caption: Tens and hundreds.
scenes.say: Four plus three is seven. Three plus four is seven. No carrying is needed.

scenes.caption: 3,777 metres in total.
scenes.say: The total is three thousand, seven hundred and seventy-seven metres.

scenes.caption: Check by adding back.
scenes.say: Check the answer by taking one hill away. You should get the second hill back.
